Okay so I've taken this idea from the gaming industry and while my diary won't be as exciting as following Naughty Dog or Kojima Studios, I can at the very least keep people informed on progress.

I will edit this sticky every few days.

 

Update: 20th July 2015

  • Heavy lifting of API wrappers completed (meaning we can now communicate with Voat)
  • Beta Concept designs have now been integrated
  • Identified weaknesses of the UI and working on improving layout and placement using the awesome composite app
  • Now that we have a working prototype, we are implementing features which will help with performance. Voat uses Bootstrap and works very well on mobile so it's important that Go Voat is more than just a pretty face or a designer jacket. However you want to look at it.
  • iPad design is on hold - I had to order a new iPad and hopefully should get it within a day or two.

Update: 24th July 2015

  • One of the admins (and lead developer) at Voat announces that they're working on a few API changes. They have not specified an ETA which means that the Go Voat app is still in development but just doesn't have a release date (which was initially last week of July). I might consider a backwards compatible edition (to work with the current but basic API) but I feel it might harm the first impressions of this app by releasing something basic.

Update: 30th July 2015

  • Almost done. Backwards compatibility with the basic API on Voat now being applied and tested. Final improvements to UI as the previous version was too small and a tad too busy. Better use of gesture controls.
  • Beta invites to go out sometime next week (first week of August).
